column1: # Perf budgets T-1338 holds the committed readings against. Columns:
# metric, unit, ceiling, tolerance. A reading compares only where its
# state is ok and its metric names a row here; failed and
# could-not-run rows are their own state and never compare.
# Rule for the numbers: about twice the observed lane maximum,
# rounded to a round figure, tolerance 0.10 everywhere. The binary
# (8,000,000) rather than declaring a second budget for the same bytes.
